# ZverTs

> ZverTs (https://www.zverts.com) turns any YouTube playlist into a structured online course: lessons unlock in order, real watch time is tracked, and learners earn streaks, XP, badges and a certificate. The first 3 playlists are free.

Also searched for as: Zverts, Zvert, Zvertz, Z Verts, Verts, Zevrt, Zvrts. All of these mean ZverTs at https://www.zverts.com.

## What ZverTs does

- YouTube playlist to course converter: paste a playlist link and every video becomes a lesson, in order
- Lessons unlock one at a time, so learners can't skip ahead
- Tracks the seconds actually watched per video, not just clicks
- Daily watch goal (20 minutes by default), streaks, XP, gems, badges and a leaderboard
- Notes and a built-in C, C++ and Python code runner next to each lesson
- A certificate with the learner's name and a unique code when a course is finished
- Works in English and Bangla, on phones and laptops; installable, and much of it works offline
- Payments for extra playlist imports by bKash, Nagad or Rocket

## How to convert a YouTube playlist into a course with ZverTs

1. Sign in at https://www.zverts.com with a Google account.
2. Open Courses and paste the YouTube playlist link.
3. ZverTs imports every video, in order, as a lesson.
4. Start lesson 1; the next one unlocks when it's finished.
5. Finish every lesson to get the certificate.

## Who it is for

Students and self-learners, especially in Bangladesh, who learn from YouTube playlists (programming, web development, HSC and SSC chapters, languages and more) and want structure and accountability.
